topic: LLM-informed warm-starting and prior injection for Bayesian optimization (CASH) of subject-specific EEG motor-imagery preprocessing pipelines, with cross-subject transfer
topic_original: 在受試者特定的 MI-BCI 前處理管線 CASH 最佳化中，讓 LLM 扮演 prior injector / cold-start initializer（或結合其他受試者的歷史搜尋結果做遷移），相較於純 cold-start 的 SMAC/VolcanoML 搜尋，能否在相同評估預算內顯著加速收斂並提升最終解碼準確率？零樣本直接遷移（zero-shot transfer）又能達到多少水準？

pico.population: Subject-specific EEG motor-imagery (MI) BCI decoding tasks on public benchmark datasets (e.g., PhysioNet EEGMMI, BCI Competition IV-2a/2b), where the full preprocessing + feature extraction + classification pipeline is treated as a CASH search space
pico.intervention: LLM-as-prior-injector / cold-start initializer for Bayesian optimization (SMAC/OpenBox/VolcanoML-style decomposed search), and meta-learned warm-starting that transfers search histories from other subjects
pico.comparison: Pure cold-start Bayesian optimization (SMAC, auto-sklearn, VolcanoML), random search, and fixed 'standard' manually-designed EEG preprocessing pipelines; zero-shot transferred configurations without further search
pico.outcome: Convergence speed under a fixed evaluation budget (anytime performance, evaluations-to-target), final decoding performance (balanced accuracy, kappa), and zero-shot transfer accuracy relative to searched optima
pico.setting: Computational/offline benchmark experiments on public EEG MI datasets; AutoML / HPO system research context
pico.timeframe: 2015-2026 (meta-learning warm-start BO from 2015; LLM-for-AutoML concentrated in 2023-2026)

queries.query: "large language model" AND ("Bayesian optimization" OR "hyperparameter optimization" OR AutoML) AND (warm-start OR "cold start" OR prior OR initialization)
queries.rationale: Direct hit on the LLM-as-prior-injector/initializer literature for BO/HPO/AutoML (e.g., LLAMBO, BORA, LB-MCTS lineage)

queries.query: (EEG OR "brain-computer interface" OR BCI) AND ("motor imagery") AND ("pipeline optimization" OR AutoML OR "combined algorithm selection" OR CASH OR "automated preprocessing")
queries.rationale: Catches EEG/BCI-side work that automates preprocessing or full-pipeline selection, regardless of whether LLMs are involved (NeuroWeaver, EEG AutoML systems)

queries.query: ("meta-learning" OR "transfer learning") AND ("Bayesian optimization" OR "hyperparameter optimization") AND (warm-start OR "warm starting" OR "search history" OR "transfer of surrogates")
queries.rationale: Finds the mechanistic foundation: how prior task/subject search histories are transferred to warm-start BO surrogates and initial designs

queries.query: (AutoML OR "hyperparameter optimization") AND (benchmark OR "anytime performance" OR "evaluation budget" OR ablation) AND ("search space decomposition" OR SMAC OR VolcanoML OR auto-sklearn)
queries.rationale: Targets rigorous system evaluations and budget-controlled comparisons that define how to measure convergence speedup fairly

queries.query: ("cross-subject" OR "inter-subject" OR "subject transfer" OR "subject-to-subject") AND (EEG OR BCI) AND (hyperparameter OR configuration OR pipeline OR "neural architecture search")
queries.rationale: Broadens to cross-subject variability/transfer work in EEG — including NAS-for-EEG and subject-adaptive decoding — whose transfer methods may apply to pipeline configuration
